messages:
alex_support: P1 escalation from support — Elmwood Labs trial failing to complete onboarding. Provision endpoint intermittently returns 403 when rotation and provisioning overlap; automation shows repeated rotate+provision race. Renewal in ~4 weeks and customer ramping. Ticket SUP-220022 opened. Looping @mira_cs for CS handoff and comms.

ops-bot: Alert: 12 provisioning failures for tenant elmwood-trial in last 10h. Error pattern: 403 rotation_conflict. https://redwood.inc/alerts/SUP-220022

mira_cs: Thanks Alex. I'll take comms. Can eng confirm whether this is tenant-side or a platform race condition? Need impacted endpoints, last successful run, and an ETA for a mitigation so I can prepare a customer note and AE brief.

alex_support: Repro (sanitized):
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.inc/v1/tenants/elmwood-trial/provision" -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_***' -d '{"config":"x"}'
# response: {"status":403,"error":"rotation_conflict","request_id":"req_elm01"}
```
Customer tried disabling auto-rotate but saw failures while their job still retried.

josh_se: We observed similar telemetry after the concurrent-rotate optimization merged yesterday — possible race where rotate job invalidates a cache while provision reads a stale state. I can run a targeted repro and prepare a short-lived maintenance key if needed.

tara_eng: Confirmed: a subtle window exists when the key state is updated in-store but read path still uses a previous validator TTL. Rolling a temporary mitigation: force-propagate the new key state and increase read coherence for tenants with active rotation jobs. ETA ~2h to push the mitigation; will follow with a permanent fix.

mira_cs: Draft customer message (short, non-technical):
"Hi Elmwood team — we9re aware of intermittent onboarding failures tied to API key rotation and provisioning occurring at the same time. We9ve prioritized this and will run a troubleshooting session if needed; in the meantime we recommend pausing automated rotation for the next 2 hours or using the temporary maintenance key we can provide. We will follow up with a full remediation plan within 24 hours. For urgent issues contact ops@redwood.com. (Ticket SUP-220022)"

sophia_ae: I'll be on the call and will update renewal watchers. Can CS include a one-paragraph impact summary I can forward to Sales? Also pls note any credits/SLAs to offer if this impacts onboarding deadline.

josh_se: I can generate the ephemeral maintenance key and coordinate a secure upload. Mira, please confirm whether Elmwood wants the key or prefers to pause rotation — I'll prepare both paths.

tara_eng: Mitigation deployed to a small set of replicas; monitoring now. If error rate drops we'll roll to prod. Will publish a short RCA once we confirm.

mira_cs: Owners: Alex = support ticket owner, Josh = SE lead (repro & temporary key), Tara = eng owner (mitigation & RCA), Sophia = AE/renewal. I'll send the customer note now and update SUP-220022 with the mitigation ETA and the calendar invite for a troubleshooting slot if they want one.

ops-bot: Incident created: INCIDENT-20260405-07. Runbook: onboarding-provisioning-race. Escalation level: CS-P1.

mira_cs: Thanks team 8588; keep ticket updates here and I'll post the final customer message once mitigation is verified.
